title: Wire Workshop messages to the existing reconstruction engine through a durable worker

callers: services/control-plane/bff/agora/strategy_workshop/router.py:2576 POST /bff/agora/workshops/{workshop_id}/reconstruct — the only call site; fully synchronous inline HTTP handler; returned the engine result in the HTTP response body only and persisted nothing
gaps: No durable admission of a reconstruction job: message posting and reconstruction were entirely disconnected (no hook from POST /messages into reconstruction)
No persistence method for StrategyReconstructionResult existed anywhere in store.py
No worker/runner module for strategy_workshop (interaction/runner.py had no counterpart)
No wiring from a reconstruction result into a canonical Registry draft

code_disposition: Kept reconstruct_strategy_from_events and its StrategyReconstructionResult schema unmodified (no second reconstruction model).
Added services/control-plane/bff/agora/strategy_workshop/runner.py: run_reconstruction_worker is the one worker path both callers now go through.

Reused existing dual-backend durable primitives instead of adding new tables/DDL: store.record_workshop_card (already upsert-by-card_id, already Postgres ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) persists exactly one effective result per workshop at a deterministic card_id (reconstruction_card_id). No new schema.

Retired the direct-only normal path: POST /bff/agora/workshops/{workshop_id}/reconstruct (router.py) now calls run_reconstruction_worker instead of calling the engine inline and discarding the result.

Wired POST /bff/agora/workshops/{workshop_id}/messages (router.py) to call the same run_reconstruction_worker immediately after the message event is durably committed via append_event_cas, best-effort (a reconstruction/Registry hiccup never fails message acceptance).

Registry draft creation reuses the existing WorkshopCanonicalOperations.create_strategy_spec/get_strategy_spec (operations.py) unchanged; no new Registry authority. A draft is only created when the workshop already has an active_strategy_spec_registry_id and the reconstruction completeness grade is above 'insufficient'; the draft carries the base StrategySpec document forward unmodified, annotated with reconstruction lineage metadata (reconstruction_id, based_on_sequence_no, completeness_grade) rather than synthesizing a new document from the strategy_map.

durability_semantics.job_identity: one durable slot per workshop_id via a deterministic card_id (reconstruction_card_id); the persisted payload's based_on_sequence_no is the conversation/version identity
durability_semantics.replay: if the persisted card is status=completed and its based_on_sequence_no equals the workshop's current max event sequence_no, the worker returns the persisted result unchanged with no engine re-invocation and no repeat Registry call
durability_semantics.stale_result: a new message advances the max sequence_no; the next worker call detects the mismatch, recomputes, and the upsert overwrites the same card slot so exactly one result stays effective
durability_semantics.crash_and_restart: a card left status=running (process died mid-flight) is not treated as a terminal state; the next call recomputes the deterministic engine output and completes the same card slot
durability_semantics.concurrency_model: synchronous-in-request execution, the same pattern services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/runner.py uses for persona invocations; no cross-process lease/lock. Durability comes from the workshop_card row being committed to the durable store (Postgres in production) before the response returns; idempotent convergence comes from the deterministic engine plus the create-then-readback Registry call being safe to repeat. This is a documented scope boundary, not a distributed lease.
